Bring 4 bespoke Nxeon marketing pages up to the site's gold-standard design, driven by buyer psychology. Work ONLY in `/opt/nxeon-wt-consist-b` (branch feature/consist-b). Commit + push when done. Do NOT run npm build/prisma — write code + `npx tsc --noEmit`.

## Gold standard (read first)
`app/page.tsx` (homepage) + `app/(marketing)/pricing/page.tsx` + `components/marketing/PricingExplorer.tsx`. Match their premium navy/violet/cyan glass look and REUSE the shared system: `components/marketing/primitives.tsx` (`PageHero`, `Section` (use `size="lg"`), `SectionTitle` (give real eyebrows), `Eyebrow`), `components/marketing/sections.tsx` (`SectionHeading`, `FeatureCard`, `CtaBand`, `TrustBadges`), CSS utils `.card`/`.card-hover`/`.lift`, `grad-text`, `.eyebrow(-pill)`, `hero-aura`, `tone-*`, `.btn-primary/.btn-secondary`, `AmbientField`, `Reveal` (stagger with `delay={i*60}` ms — NOT 0.05). Geist font is already global.

## HARD RULES
- **KEEP ALL COPY, CLAIMS, STATS, and REVIEW elements verbatim** — this is a DESIGN-ONLY pass. Do not delete/reword any headline, number, stat, or claim; do not remove or change `ReviewBadges`/review content. You may re-order/re-group/re-style sections. No NEW invented stats.
- **Do NOT do any VAT/pricing-logic work.** Any price shown must stay DB-fed (reuse existing queries/helpers); first-month-free stays hosting-only; don't add $0 cues to non-hosting.
- No amber except semantic; motion-safe only (respect reduced-motion).

## Buyer psychology (apply in the restyle)
Strong above-the-fold (hero: headline + value + primary CTA + trust row); anchor the "popular/featured" tier with the site's `.card lift … glow-brand` pattern (see business-email/block-storage); social proof near CTAs; clear single primary action per section; scannable benefit-first copy; close with `CtaBand`.

## The work
1. **Parameterize `CtaBand` in `components/marketing/sections.tsx`** — add optional `title`/`sub`/`primary`/`secondary` props (default to the current hardcoded copy so existing callers are unchanged). You OWN this shared file; the other agents will not touch it.
2. **`app/(marketing)/matrix/page.tsx`** — replace the ~35-line hand-rolled hero (around L127-165) with `PageHero` (trust row as children, the `ConsoleMatrix` visual right after); replace the hand-built "why" icon grid with `FeatureCard`; replace the forked CtaBand block (~L331-360) with `<CtaBand title=… />`. Keep all copy/claims.
3. **`app/(marketing)/migrate/page.tsx`** — replace the forked CtaBand (~L274-300) with `<CtaBand title=… />`; align hero + sections to `PageHero`/`Section size=lg`/`SectionTitle` with eyebrows.
4. **`app/(marketing)/revsports/page.tsx`** — replace the forked CtaBand (~L166-192) with `<CtaBand title=… />`; align to the system.
5. **`app/(marketing)/nxcloud/page.tsx`** — the biggest one: swap hand-rolled cards (`rounded-2xl border-white/[0.08] bg-navy-850/60`, ~L89/108-110/145) to `className="card"`; the featured tier (L108-110, currently `border-brand-500/50 bg-brand-500/[0.06]`) to the `.card lift … glow-brand` popular pattern; fix `Reveal delay` to `i*60`; `Section size="lg"` + add eyebrows to `SectionTitle`s.

## Output
tsc clean (report it); commit + push to origin/feature/consist-b. Report per-page: new section order, primitives adopted, and confirm all original copy/claims/reviews kept + prices still DB-fed. Previews on staging before going live.
